description: Opera Neon through Opera's own installer, launched: found installed by its launcher and running by the path it runs from.
why: Two witnesses, one per route: the file row is the installed one and the proc row the running one. require_rows holds each separately, so the scenario cannot pass on one route while the other is broken; 118 proves the installed one alone. Cursor is forbidden because its value is the other process path under ~\AppData\Local\Programs.
known_gaps: A match says Opera Neon is installed, not that Neon Do ran or a subscription is active: no route reads either.
Only the per-user install is read. A machine-wide one (the installer's --allusers=1) is not installed here, and a path outside a home is one no `~/` value names.
